extraction.name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
extraction.description: A dataset and challenge for advanced question answering consisting of 7,787 natural grade-school science questions from standardized tests, partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set. It is released together with the ARC Corpus of 14M science sentences and baseline models to encourage research on reasoning-intensive QA.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled through several months of extensive search and investigation to obtain natural science questions authored for standardized tests, and was then partitioned into Challenge and Easy sets based on baseline system performance.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Natural science multiple-choice questions authored for standardized tests; additionally, a science text corpus containing 14M science-related sentences was released.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions were not newly human-labeled; the dataset consists of existing natural, standardized-test multiple-choice science questions, and the Challenge/Easy partition was created automatically based on whether two baseline solvers answered each question incorrectly or correctly.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper analyzes the automatic partitioning criterion by describing Challenge questions as those missed by both the IR and PMI baseline solvers, and discusses the effect of these filters with examples.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Automatic filtering/partitioning used an Information Retrieval (IR) solver with Elasticsearch and a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) solver.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to natural science questions from standardized tests and is intentionally designed to be difficult for simple retrieval and word co-occurrence methods; the paper also notes difficulty in obtaining such questions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to steer AI research toward more advanced reasoning and deeper text comprehension, influencing the direction of the research community.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is released to encourage AI research in advanced question answering, particularly questions requiring reasoning, commonsense knowledge, and deeper text comprehension; it is also used as a benchmark challenge with baselines, leaderboard access, and submission of new entries.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset, corpus, and baseline models are released and hosted via the ARC website/leaderboard, but no explicit update timeframe, maintainers, or deprecation policy is provided.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set based on whether baseline retrieval-based and word co-occurrence algorithms answered the questions incorrectly.
